analysis:
Market regime: SPY in a modest uptrend (+0.3% vs SMA50, 20d slope +0.70%) — not a screaming bull, but conditions favor staying long in quality names. Portfolio at 88% deployed with 6 open positions, which already exceeds the 3-5 concentrated position target. Only $6,302 headroom remains before selling anything, making any new entry impossible without freeing capital first.

Position reviews:
- ULTA (+8.53%): Thesis intact, winner running. Hold.
- UHS (-0.32%): Essentially flat, healthcare thesis intact. Hold.
- FOXA (-1.63%): Recently re-entered, slight loss but within normal noise. Hold.
- ADSK (-0.49%): Mixed/sideways, still on screened list (PEG 0.82, strong FCF). Thesis intact. Hold.
- NVDA (-4.79%): Pullback within AI/GPU cycle. Still on screened list. Hold unless SMA200 breaks.
- AMP (-9.00%): Most concerning position. AMP does NOT appear on today's screened candidate list — meaning it has either entered a confirmed downtrend or failed quality filters. At -9% from avg cost and absent from the quality+trend screen, the thesis is effectively flagged as compromised by the model's own filters. With 6 positions already exceeding the 5-name cap, AMP is the clear candidate for exit. Freeing this capital (~$9,460) plus existing cash gives ~$20,600 to deploy into a better setup.

New trade: TEL (TE Connectivity) is the most compelling setup from the candidate list — UPTREND at 55% of 52w range (not extended), PEG 0.95, fwd P/E 14.73, ROE 24.6%, operating margin 19%, revenue growth 11.9%, and EPS revisions +4.1% trending higher. Earnings 82 days away gives a full position window. Quality connector business with broad industrial + EV/data center exposure at a fair price. The combo of reasonable valuation, clean uptrend, and positive analyst revision momentum provides the asymmetric setup the strategy demands.
